summary.intent: Resolve open PR review comments related to a change that allowed recycleBinRetentionDays to be set to 0 (previously min was 1).
summary.outcome: All 4 unresolved review threads were triaged and resolved: one was already addressed in a prior commit, two required doc/JSDoc fixes, and one was marked not applicable. Fixes were committed and pushed.

repo: cipher-box uses a planning docs directory at .planning/phases/<phase-id>/ with SUMMARY.md files that must be kept in sync with code changes
The vault's recycleBinRetentionDays field previously had a min of 1; it was changed to allow 0 to mean 'disabled'
The web app deprecates certain API endpoints client-side but desktop/other clients still consume them, so server endpoints should not be removed

code.finding: JSDoc range comment for recycleBinRetentionDays needed updating to reflect new minimum of 0 after the retention change
Planning summary doc had stale range description for recycleBinRetentionDays and required a manual update
Client-side deprecation of an API endpoint does not justify removing the server endpoint — other clients (desktop) still depend on it

workflow: CodeRabbit or similar automated reviewers flag JSDoc and planning doc inconsistencies alongside code changes — these must be updated together
When a behavior boundary changes (e.g., min value), existing tests asserting the old boundary must be updated and new edge-case tests added
Background tasks (git push) can be dispatched async and their completion picked up via task notifications without blocking other work

friction: One of the 4 review threads was for an issue already fixed in a prior commit (77a4774c9), requiring manual triage to avoid duplicate work
